claims.claim_vi: PEP 8: code is read much more often than it is written and the guidelines aim at readability and consistency; constants are usually module-level and in all capital letters with underscores; inline comments that state the obvious are unnecessary and distracting; comments that contradict the code are worse than none; a bare except catches SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt and can disguise other problems.
claims.verified_by: Read from a raw copy at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: The Google Java Style Guide describes itself as the complete definition of Google's coding standards for Java source; a file is in Google Style if and only if it follows the rules.

claims.claim_vi: unittest: a test case checks a specific response to a particular set of inputs; assertRaises verifies that an exception is raised.
claims.verified_by: Read from a raw copy at the pinned commit.

The source's sentences and its examples (PEP 8 and Google Java Style as names) are not copied; the style and test points are read from the documents themselves.
